rows.en:
S-sorry...
I've got something to do today... See ya.
Got it. See ya.

(Lately Hoshimura's been kind of
avoiding hanging out with me...)

(Hmm... No use worrying about it.
Guess I'll go grab a bite at Nyan-Nyan.)

Welcome, welcome!
A table for how ma......ny, aru~?
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. She stalls mid-word on recognising the player. Fake-Chinese verbal tic (aru) kept as "aru".

rows.en: What are you doing, Hoshimura?

Who is this Hoshimura you speak of, aru?
My name's not Yui or anything, aru~
rows.notes: Hoshimura, male scene. The slip (denying a name nobody said) is the joke. Fake-Chinese verbal tic (aru) kept as "aru".

rows.en:
Now, now, now, dear customer,
never mind all that, your seat is this way, aru~
rows.notes: Hoshimura, male scene. Fake-Chinese verbal tic (aru) kept as "aru".

rows.en:
(Hoshimura's determined to play dumb
to the bitter end, huh...)
Whoa! Hey, Hoshimura!
rows.notes: Male; she bumps into something (see next row).

rows.en:
You'll get hurt if you don't watch
where you're going...

(Hoshimura got let off her shift early,
so we came to Central Park together, but...)

(Neither of us has said a word
this whole time...)

Uuu... Today's screwups and all...
It's all, all your fault......

When you're around,
I just can't be my usual self!
Even the China dress is too embarrassing...!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, male scene. (kimi no mae ja hazukashikute) "in front of you" folded into the context.

rows.en:
Huh? But you were totally into wearing it
at the Culture Fest, weren't you...?
That was then, this is now!!

And you wore a nurse outfit when I was in the
hospital... You even said, 'If you ever wanna
see me as a nurse, just say the word,' right?

Aaah! Aaah!
I don't know! I don't know anything!!

Anyway, being around you makes me happy and
it's fun, but it's even MORE embarrassing!
At this rate, it's like I... about you...!!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, male scene. Trails off before the confession, as in the Japanese (kimi no koto...).

rows.en: ...Oh, I see... So that's what this is...
rows.notes: Hoshimura, male scene. She realises her feelings.

rows.en: Hoshimura?

Yeah, sorry about all that.
Ranting away all by myself...
I'm okay now... I'm okay, really.

Don't you worry. Next time we meet,
I'll be the usual, full-of-energy Yui-san!
Are you really okay?
Yup! I'm okay!
By next time, I'll definitely...
rows.notes: Hoshimura, male scene. Trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en: See you later, then!
(What was Hoshimura trying to say, anyway?)

(Toward the end, she had a look on her face
like she'd made up her mind about something...)
(Did I do something to upset Hoshimura...?)
Okay. See you.

(Lately Yui's been kind of
avoiding hanging out with me...)

(Hmm... No use worrying about it.
Maybe I'll go grab a bite at Nyan-Nyan.)
What are you doing, Yui?

Who is this Yui you speak of, aru?
My name's not Yui or anything, aru~
rows.notes: Hoshimura, female scene. Fake-Chinese verbal tic (aru) kept as "aru".

rows.en:
(Yui's determined to play dumb
to the bitter end, huh...)

Now, now, now, dear customer,
never mind all that, your seat is this way, aru~
rows.notes: Hoshimura, female scene. Fake-Chinese verbal tic (aru) kept as "aru".

rows.en: Whoa! Hey, Yui!

You'll get hurt if you don't watch
where you're going...

(Yui got let off her shift early,
so we came to Central Park together, but...)
Are you okay, Yui?
I'm okay...
(She sure doesn't look it...)
Hey, Yui, if something's bothering you......

......Right! Moping around like this
isn't very Yui-san of me!

Well, see, lately being around you has been
so much fun that I couldn't be my usual self.

Like, I'd get all hyped up
and just end up spinning my wheels...
So that's what it was...
That's why I was kinda avoiding you a bit too...

So, give me a little time to sort out my feelings...
Next time we meet, I'll be the usual,
full-of-energy Yui-san!
Okay, got it.
rows.notes: Female; x4 (also Valentine scenes); as c07131.

rows.en: Thanks! See you later, then!
(I'm glad Yui seems to be back to her old self.)

(Being told I'm too much fun to be around
makes me happy, but it's a little embarrassing too.)

(I came to Nyan-Nyan for lunch.
I wonder if Hoshimura would come if I asked her?)
(All right, I'll give her a call.)
Hello, Yui here!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. Voicemail greeting begins.

rows.en:
Oh, Hoshimura.
It's \p...
At the moment, I am...
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. Voicemail; continues in c14564.

rows.en:
(Oh, it's her voicemail.
There's no point leaving a message...)

...off training in the mountains, or maybe not,
to prepare for the coming battle with \p.
(What is with this voicemail greeting...)

Next time we meet, I'll have a bang, squeeze,
BAAANG! dynamite body,
so look forward to it!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. (bon, kyu, boon: bust-waist-hips).

rows.en:
If you have business with the new me,
leave a message after the sound
of a Valkyrie transforming!
(What on earth is Hoshimura up to...?)

(I came to Nyan-Nyan for lunch.
I wonder if Yui would come if I asked her?)
(All right, I'll give her a call.)

Oh, Yui.
It's \p...
(What is with this voicemail greeting...)
(What on earth is Yui up to...?)
